title: Continuity Agent v1 · 14-day execution schedule
success_metric: At least one real external user completes an audit and provides attributable feedback.

days.title: Freeze positioning and acceptance
days.objective: Keep the product claim narrow: it judges generated continuity rather than promising production generation.
tasks: Write the one-sentence positioning and four decision outcomes.
Publish measurable acceptance criteria and explicit capability gaps.

deliverables.description: Explicit limits and unsupported quality claims.

days.title: Freeze architecture boundaries
days.objective: Separate planning, deterministic continuity rules, auditing, reports, and optional providers.
tasks: Document component ownership and state flow.
Keep provider credentials and paid generation outside the default path.

deliverables.description: Architecture, privacy, retry, and provider boundaries.

days.title: Lock public data contracts
days.objective: Make canon inputs and audit outputs versioned and machine-checkable.
tasks: Validate canon and AuditResult at module boundaries.
Publish JSON Schema without adding runtime dependencies.

days.title: Extract the high-confidence rule set
days.objective: Run deterministic rules as plugins and send uncertainty to human review.
tasks: Implement stable rule ordering and scoped compilation.
Separate pixel, reference, temporal, identity, and human-review rules.

days.title: Benchmark and calibration gate
days.objective: Ground identity thresholds in separated calibration and validation data, or keep the claim provisional.
tasks: Measure match, ambiguous, and mismatch distributions.
Reject production-ready threshold claims when real samples are insufficient.

deliverables.description: Dataset protocol and minimum sample requirements.

evidence_sets.label: Real validation split meets the documented readiness threshold.
Threshold remains explicitly provisional; unsupported score claims stay blocked.

gate.failure_action: Reduce the automatic rule set and keep identity in HUMAN REVIEW; do not tune on validation data.

days.title: Stabilize ffmpeg ingestion
days.objective: Make CPU video sampling deterministic and degrade cleanly when ffmpeg is unavailable.
tasks: Probe the real ffmpeg executable before exposing video controls.
Verify ordered frame extraction and no-ffmpeg fallback.

deliverables.description: Validated ffmpeg probe and ordered sampling.

days.title: Integration-output gate
days.objective: Provide adapter-readable JSON, a human report, integrity checks, and stable command exit codes before adding a film loop.
tasks: Package one audit without source media or global production logs.
Expose validated JSON plus human-readable output and stable exit behavior.

deliverables.description: Stable command entry point and exit codes.

evidence_sets.label: Machine and human outputs plus exit codes are implemented and tested.

gate.failure_action: Cut the one-sentence film loop and reinvest the remaining time in benchmark quality and distribution.

days.title: Build the six-shot film loop
days.objective: Demonstrate prompt to canon-constrained shotlist to blocker-only repair without changing the validator's product claim.
tasks: Use exactly one vendor and six shots.
Regenerate blocker shots only for at most two rounds, then concatenate the latest takes.

days.title: Freeze the daily execution schedule
days.objective: Turn the fourteen-day plan and its hard gates into a validated repository contract.
tasks: Encode all days, dependencies, deliverables, fallbacks, and gates.
Expose current evidence and next work through continuity schedule.

days.title: Deploy with a zero-surprise cost boundary
days.objective: Publish a CPU deployment path, health check, rollback notes, and explicit free-versus-paid cost table.
tasks: Document local and public deployment commands.
Record resource limits, secrets, cost ceilings, and rollback steps.

deliverables.description: Deployment, health, rollback, and cost runbook.

days.title: Real external-user gate
days.objective: Get at least one person outside the builder to complete an audit and report what blocked them.
tasks: Send the validator to a real AI-video creator or editor.
Record consent-safe, attributable usage evidence and the top failure.

deliverables.description: Redacted external-user session and feedback evidence.

evidence_sets.label: At least one real external user completed the core audit flow.

gate.failure_action: Stop adding features; spend the remaining time on direct outreach, onboarding friction, and one observed user session.

days.title: Fix the observed adoption blocker
days.objective: Use real-user evidence to make one measurable onboarding or workflow improvement.
tasks: Rank feedback by whether it prevents completion of the audit flow.
Fix the highest-impact blocker and add a regression test.

deliverables.description: Observed blocker, fix, and before/after evidence.

days.title: Publish risk lines and portfolio evidence
days.objective: State what v1 will not claim and convert verified work into a concise case study.
tasks: Publish stop conditions and post-v1 backlog boundaries.
Write the portfolio case around evidence, failures, and saved regeneration.

deliverables.description: Risk register and explicit cut lines.

days.title: Release v1 and freeze claims
days.objective: Ship one reproducible release whose documentation, tests, demo, and claims agree.
tasks: Run the complete regression suite from a clean environment.
Publish the changelog and release checklist without upgrading provisional claims.

deliverables.description: v1 release notes and verification record.
